decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's established stollen know-how and with repeated gold-medal recognition, this product fits existing capabilities and gives strong evidence that the firm can keep learning from and profitably refine it.

This rye-based bread sits near the firm's core baking knowledge and its continued standalone presence suggests acceptable market traction, so management would likely retain it while using existing production and recipe expertise to improve it further.

Marzipan Christmas stollen is highly related to the firm's apparent seasonal bakery competence, and because it remained actively presented over two years, management would likely see enough absorptive capacity and commercial fit to continue it.
